mentions.name: aether
mentions.description: A server-client text editor with native, terminal, and web clients sharing a single local server instance. It integrates LSP, tree-sitter, ripgrep, and Git, provides workspaces for switching between projects, and is oriented toward exploring code rather than editing. Keybindings are structured so bare letters handle motions, Shift variants extend selections, Ctrl bindings perform buffer mutations, and leader-prefixed bindings trigger application-level actions like opening pickers.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been building a text editor. It uses a server-client model, with native/terminal/web clients using a shared (local) server instance. It integrates LSP/tree-sitter/ripgrep/Git/etc, and has a concept of 'workspaces' to easily switch between projects.
mentions.author: joefreeman
